summary.en: The Safe calls its own `changeThreshold`, setting how many signers must sign before a transaction can run to the number you type. The list of signers does not change.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫自己的 `changeThreshold`，把需要幾個簽署人簽才能執行改成你填的數字。簽署人名單不變。

text.en: Moves no asset, but the threshold decides how many keys can control this Safe.
text.zh-TW: 不動任何資產，但門檻決定幾把鑰匙就能動這個 Safe。

pastTxsConclusion.en: Every misfit batches the threshold with owner changes, some with enableModule calls, which kiss-sign refuses.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 不合的都是把門檻和 owner 變更一起送，有的還加 enableModule，kiss-sign 不接受。

text.en: A threshold of 1 means any one signer can move all the assets. With the threshold equal to the number of signers, losing one key leaves the Safe unable to act ever again.
text.zh-TW: 門檻 1 表示任何一個簽署人就能動全部資產；門檻等於人數時，少一把鑰匙就再也動不了。

recommendation.en: Set the threshold between the two, for example 2 of 3 signers.
recommendation.zh-TW: 門檻介於兩者之間，例如 3 人設 2。
